notes.title: Infinity Mode Update
notes.notes:
- New game mode added (Infinity Mode) where you can find all the characters you've already unlocked in a continuous play style.

- Huge performance optmizations on play mode.

notes.title: V1.01 Difficulty Update
notes.notes:
Seeing people struggling with the game we decided to greatly reduce the overral difficulty of the first levels and moderately the later ones. 

This way we expect people to feel less frustrated on the first touch with the game. 

For good players there will still be a nice challenge after you clear the first 2 worlds. We did not change the extra world's difficulty. 

Thanks for your support!
